tool_schemas.name: generateDiagram
tool_schemas.description: Creates and stores a new diagram generation request for the specified project, recording the provided input_spec (verbatim) and returning the created request record (and any generator metadata) for downstream job processing; if idempotency_key is provided, repeated calls with the same key for the same project return the originally created request instead of creating a duplicate. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id does not match the expected format, if input_spec is missing/invalid, if generator_version/idempotency_key violate length constraints, or if unknown fields are supplied. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to create requests for the project, NOT_FOUND if the referenced project_id does not exist, and CONFLICT if the same idempotency_key is reused with a different request payload (project_id, input_spec, or generator_version).

project_id.description: ID of the project to associate this diagram generation with.

input_spec.description: Generator input specification used to produce the diagram (stored verbatim for audit/debug).

idempotency_key.description: Client-provided idempotency key to deduplicate repeated generation requests.

generator_version.description: Optional generator version identifier to run (if omitted, server uses default).

tool_schemas.name: listProjects
tool_schemas.description: Lists projects visible to the calling API key, optionally filtered by status and free-text query, returning a paginated result set ordered by created_at descending. Refuses invalid pagination parameters.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring match against project name/description.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: createProject
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new project owned/accessible to the calling API key and returns the created project record. Refuses requests with missing/invalid fields.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

tool_schemas.name: updateProject
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on an existing project and/or transitions its status according to the project lifecycle. Returns the updated project record. Refuses invalid transitions (e.g., deleted -> active) or attempts to modify a deleted project.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

project_id.description: ID of the project to update.

status.description: New lifecycle status. Allowed transitions: active->archived/deleted; archived->active/deleted.

tool_schemas.name: listDiagramGenerations
tool_schemas.description: Lists diagram generation requests for a project, optionally filtered by status and idempotency_key, returning a paginated result set ordered by created_at descending. Refuses invalid filters or pagination parameters.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

project_id.description: Project whose generation requests to list.

idempotency_key.description: Filter generations by client idempotency key.

limit.description: Maximum number of generations to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: getDiagramGeneration
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single diagram generation request by id and returns the full record including status and timing fields. Refuses access if the generation is not visible to the calling API key.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

generation_id.description: ID of the diagram generation request to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: listDiagramArtifacts
tool_schemas.description: Lists artifacts produced for a diagram generation, optionally filtered by artifact_type, returning a paginated result set ordered by created_at ascending. Refuses invalid filters or pagination parameters.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

generation_id.description: ID of the generation whose artifacts to list.

limit.description: Maximum number of artifacts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

metadata.name: Eraser Diagram Generator
metadata.description: This backend stores requests to generate Eraser diagrams and the resulting diagram artifacts produced by a generator service. The main workflow is: a client submits a generation request, the system runs a job to produce an Eraser-compatible output, stores the artifact(s), and records usage for audit
